== The ennead challenge —  '''maximum level 80''' ==

A low level challenge that rewards you with a new skill and other useful midgame perks.

Go to the Kurast 3000 BA uberlevel on any difficulty and kill the Ennead [[Necromancer]] bosses until your class charm drops. Each [[Necromancer]] drops a random charm, so if you are unlucky, just restart the game and try again.

See [[Level ubers#Kurast 3000 BA|Kurast 3000 BA]] for more information.

If you are level 80 or below, cube the charm with a jewel to add extra bonuses and unlock your Ennead Challenge skill.

[Class Charm] + any jewel -> returns [Class Charm] with added bonuses

Requires: level 80 or below<br>

''This upgrade recipe adds ''Maximum Skill Level Increased by 1'' as well as the following bonuses:''

'''Your free bonus skill'''<br> This skill can be found at the bottom right of your third skill tab. When you complete the Ennead Challenge, upgrade your class charm and keep it into your inventory. This allows you to put skill points into the skill.
